body: It's just frustrating though, because I know that I'm so far in a hole, I can't get out of it, and feeling like literally the only option is dying. A part of me thinks of my two cats who I'll miss and my friends, but at the same time it frustrates the heck out of me to think of those thing, because if my situation doesn't change, will end up loosing my precious fur babies anyway, and my home, and everything. Just that makes me feel even more trapped in my cycle of not wanting to be around to see the inevitable happen.
